Android may stop this app\'s child processes - the porter and its tools - so a port can die with \"exit 137\" and no error. Switching the limit off is recommended.
This Android version does not let the app read the limit. If a program stops by itself, switch the limit off by hand.

Android 12 and newer stop an app\'s child processes above a limit (32). The Linux environment starts many of them, so a port can stop by itself, with no error. The app can switch the limit off, once, without a PC.

The game speaks Switch positions (X on top, Y on the left, A on the right, B at the bottom); what the controller prints on its buttons is only a sticker. This preset binds the face buttons by the Xbox print (the bottom one A, the right one B, the top one Y, the left one X).

Player 1 is the phone: the on-screen gamepad and the motion are its, and it takes the controllers nobody else plays (automatic). Lock it to one controller and the others sit out. A controller plays one player only.
